label: Log incoming messages to a file
info: Keeps a CSV record of every message you receive: time, sender, kind and the start of the text.

name: Setup
info: Before you run this flow: open the Turbo Notify account node, paste an API key and press Test. Your Turbo Notify account needs a WhatsApp number linked to it. The key needs the events:read scope. The file node appends a line per message to whatsapp-messages.csv in the folder where Node-RED runs: change the path in the file node. Keep the file private, it holds your customers' numbers.

name: write the CSV line
